title: Lamina
description: Customize the scale and position of each vanilla HUD element independently.
body:
Lamina lets you independently customize the scale and position of each vanilla HUD element.

Instead of using a single global GUI scale, you can configure the hotbar, crosshair, health, food, armor, experience bar, air bubbles, boss bar, scoreboard and action bar separately.

## Features
- Individual HUD scaling with Auto, 1x, 2x, 3x and 4x options
- Visual drag-and-drop HUD editor
- Reset buttons for restoring default settings and positions
- Optional Mod Menu configuration screen
- Client-side only: no server installation required

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader 0.19.2 or newer
- Fabric API 0.148.0+26.1.2 or newer
- Java 25
- Mod Menu 18.0.0-beta.1 is optional
